:::{#exr-cross-entropy-numeric-definition}

#### Cross-entropy of two mass functions from the definition

Let $p = (\tfrac{1}{2}, \tfrac{1}{4}, \tfrac{1}{4})$ and $q = (\tfrac{1}{4}, \tfrac{1}{2}, \tfrac{1}{4})$ be [probability mass functions](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) on $\set{1, 2, 3}$.

1.  Compute the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $\crossentropyf{p}{q}$ in bits from its definition.
2.  Compare it with your value of $\E{-\log_2 q_X}$ from @exr-cross-entropy-numeric-expectation, where $X$ has [probability mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) $p$.

:::
